arabic text: (MAULA TERE FAKIR KEH) ASHKO KI HAI DUA
english translation text: This is the prayer carried in the tears of your beggar, O Maula:
May the Lady be pleased with us.

arabic text: ( RAAZI HAMEI YAKEEN HAI ) HOJAEGA KHUDA
english translation text: We are certain that when she is pleased, God will also be pleased.

arabic text: HAISIYAT WOH BI NAHI HAIN TAKHTE- SHAHI KI KOI\nKIMTI HAI IS KADAR-KUSH NUDIYE BINTE NABI\n(FIKHRA DIYA JAHAAN KO) JISNE BI TEH KIYA
english translation text: Even a royal throne has no value beside this honour.\nSo precious is the joy of the Prophet’s daughter.\nThe one who won her pleasure was granted the pride of both worlds.

arabic text:
DAULATO SHOHRAT HAI KYA YEH ZINDAGI KUCH BHI
NAHIN
MARZIYE ZAHRA NA HOTO BANDE GHI KUCH BI NAHI
(MUFHOON HAI MUWADATE ) AALE RASUL KA
english translation text:
What are wealth and fame? This life itself is nothing.
Without Zahra’s pleasure, even servitude has no worth.
The essence of devotion is love
for the family of the Messenger.

arabic text: DAARSE AADABE WAFA DARI HAMEI JISE MILA\nMADRESSA ABBAS HAI HAR AASHI KE SHABBIR KA\n(JISKI HAYAT O MAWT KA) MAQSAD YAHI RAHA
english translation text: From his door we learned the manners of loyalty.\nAbbas is the school for every lover of Shabbir.\nThis alone remained the purpose of his life and death.

arabic text:
TAARIKE NE VEKHE KARBAL WICH DO VEER SHABBIR
TE GHAZI
EK VEER RAAZI RAB KI TA EK VEER RAAZI RAB KI TA
EK VEER NE ZAHRA RAAZI
english translation text:
History saw two brothers in Karbala:
Shabbir and Ghazi.
One brother was pleased with his Lord,
and the other earned Zahra’s pleasure.

arabic text: KAT GAYE BAAZU JARIKE HOGAYA THANDA ALAM\nMASHK SE PAANI BAHAA AUR REHGAYE PYAASE HARAM\n(ZAKHMO KO APNE BHOOL KE) GHAZI NE KI DUA
english translation text: The warrior’s arms were severed and the standard fell still.\nWater poured from the waterskin while the children remained thirsty.\nForgetting his own wounds, Ghazi prayed—

arabic text: WAQT AKHIR RAKH KE SAR ZAANU PE YEH SHEHNE\nKAHA
english translation text: At the final moment,\nthe Master placed his head upon his lap and said:

arabic text: KOI HASRAT DILME HO THO KEHDO MERE BAWAFA\n( NAZRE UTHA KE GHAZI NE) SHABBIR SE KAHA HAI
english translation text: If any longing remains in your heart, tell me, my faithful one.\nGhazi raised his eyes and replied to Shabbir—

arabic text:
JAB SUNE UMMUL-BANEEN NE AY TAKALLUM YEH
KHABAR
HOGAYA QURBAN GHAAZI FATEMA KE LAAL PAR
(YE KEHKE MAANE SHUKR KA) SAJDAH ATA KIYA
english translation text:
When Ummul Baneen heard this news, O Takallum,
that Ghazi had been sacrificed
for Fatima’s son,
she bowed in a prostration of gratitude.
